title: Group values with a structure
objective: Define a structure with named fields, make one, read a field, and change it.

body.text: A structure groups related values under names. structure gives it a name, and each has line adds one named field with its type. make ... with builds one, giving every field a value after with. Read a field with its name and of, as in name of player.

body.title: Make a player
body.code:
structure player
    has name of type text
    has score of type number

make changing player equal to a player with name "Bo" and score 0
set score of player to 7
say "{name of player} has {score of player}"

body.text: To change a field, the variable must be made changing, just like a number. If you leave a field out when you make the structure, the compiler stops and names the missing field.

body.prompt: Ada starts with 0 points and then scores 10, but the program still reports 0. Make it say Ada has 10.
body.starter:
structure player
    has name of type text
    has score of type number

make changing player equal to a player with name "Ada" and score 0
say "{name of player} has {score of player}"
body.solution:
structure player
    has name of type text
    has score of type number

make changing player equal to a player with name "Ada" and score 0
set score of player to 10
say "{name of player} has {score of player}"
